question: Find the work done moving a charge of 3 C across a potential difference of 9 V.
source:
V = W/Q
Potential difference V is work W in joules divided by charge Q in coulombs.

question: A thin converging lens has focal length +0.25 m. Find its power in dioptres.
source:
P = 1/f
Lens power P is in dioptres when focal length f is in metres.
